FunAvocado1681 EEE141- RQN
He is so humble, responsive and patient as a teacher. In class no matter how many times I ask questions, he never felt disturbed or not even got angry a bit. I didn’t feel bored in his class as he teaches the concepts by solving math primarily.
There was almost no confusion in any class as he answered to my questions patiently. Even if I face any problem understanding any topic/math/specific concept, he helped me during his office hours. Before starting each class he solved our problem from the previous class.
The exam question was standard, you can say easy as he gives all questions from examples from the book and exercise problems which are from his assignments. Just practicing them is enough.
The best part, sir took feedback on improving his teaching style before mid. In early classes he asked whether he should teach slowly or not, which indicates his concern whether we are understanding or not and his improving mindset.

How should I study to get an A?
Mohibul Islam Badhon keno best...details bol

24/7 study
Erporo A na paile poisa ferot
Exercise er math practice korte hobe beshi beshi. Nd sir ja poray oigular notes must!!

If you follow class lectures and practice accordingly, getting an A is easy. Most students who give bad reviews skip or sleep in class. Sir explains all of the concepts and solves a lot of problems in class. The quiz and mid-question questions are straightforward from the practice problems he solved in class. The final question was a little tricky. In the end, he curved a lot. I got 97/100, but he also gave an A to the second highest, which was around 83 maybe.
241 course itself is a bit difficult as it deals with complex numbers. If you don't practice regularly, you won't be able to solve the problems properly in the exam hall.
